verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out, data-use policy, or statement that user data is excluded from AI model training. Self-hosting ('that place is yours') and running agents against local providers like Ollama are adjacent arrangements that may keep data in-house, but they are not a documented product capability for preventing training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
